text: Bob27 merge lesson: when a later patchset lacks a queue-dev manifest but has an apply script and README/VALIDATION, use merge-plan for canonical inputs, inspect the noncanonical patch manually, and apply only after verifying the claimed base. Bob24 queue-plan ingestion was version-stale against 0.18.116, so carry forward additive helper/docs/tests and splice only the queue plan facade instead of copying an older queuebash.sh.
